description: Principal is a member of a group; traversal grants the group's rights with no action taken.

telemetry.detail: Group membership is a standing relationship, not an event. Reading it via LDAP is the only observable, and only if LDAP query auditing is tuned.

abuse_primitive: No action; the principal already holds the membership.
notes: Effectively free to traverse. Kept near-zero so path scoring does not penalise legitimate group inheritance.
